summary: Acceptance fails at HEAD 55ef0204 (second run, delta since d987d079). Two blocking text defects remain in lines that the remediation 2cbe1d0d changed. The plan T3 wrapper gate command exits 1 as written. test-strategy.md now calls the committed-files case 10, but its own case map calls it 9. The product stays sound: no production file changed, the suite passes 86 tests, tsc reports 0 errors in the sound-set tests, and the doctor and the facts check exit 0. F1 of the first acceptance is closed.
blocking_findings: F7 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: plan.md:116 (changed by 2cbe1d0d) gives a wrapper gate command that exits 1 as written. I ran it through heavy-run, and it printed 'sound-set: earshot not found at /tmp/tmp.uD7D0PUVx0/.venv-earshot/bin/earshot; run scripts/sound-setup.sh'. With SOUNDS_ROOT set to the scratch folder, the wrapper looks for the binary under that folder, and that folder holds no venv. The plan says 'with exit 0', so the plan text is false and the AC6 command cannot pass (A5). red-r5.log records no run of this command. Fix: add EARSHOT_BIN=$PWD/.venv-earshot/bin/earshot to the command. I ran that variant at 55ef0204: exit 0, 7 sounds, git status --short sounds/ clean, and decoded audio equal to the committed files. Run the exact final command and record its exit code. Also change test-strategy.md:149-150 (closeout gate step 3). It still names the real-root command, and the file never mentions a scratch root, so the F2 hazard stays. Rationale: the closeout role gets two conflicting gate commands, and one of them exits 1.

F8 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: test-strategy.md:122, :133, :165, and :196 (changed by 2cbe1d0d) call the committed-files case 'case 10'. The case map in the same file labels it '9 Committed files' (test-strategy.md:114) and ends at 9. The number 10 is also D5 failure class 10 (test-strategy.md:85), so the new label is ambiguous. The T8 text at plan.md:233-234 says the case is 10 in test-strategy.md, and that is false for the strategy numbering. The plan.md edits (case 10 at plan.md:77 and :83) are correct for the plan numbering (plan.md:73). Fix: restore 'case 9' at the four test-strategy.md sites, or relabel the case map so one numbering holds, and correct the T8 wording. Rationale: the remediation added an inconsistency in the lines it changed.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance (carried from review-a F5, unchanged): plan.md:166 marks T5 with [ ] and the owner text deferred:closeout-steward. countPlanTasks at measure/tools/common.mjs:113 counts only [ ], [~], and [x], so a [b] marker would not count. The doctor needs one unchecked task while the track is in_progress. The closeout role should flip T5, set the status to completed in metadata.json and measure/tracks.md, regenerate the facts, and archive the track in one step.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance (carried from review-b F1 and F2, unchanged): D4 pins only the earshot commit, and pip freeze lists unpinned transitive packages (numpy 2.4.6, numba 0.68.1, scipy 1.17.1, soundfile 0.14.0, soxr 1.1.0, cffi 2.1.1, llvmlite 0.50.0). scripts/sound-setup.sh:11 runs rm -rf .venv-earshot before each interpreter attempt. Plan T3 asks the builder to record deferred work in the owning track. measure/tech-debt.md and the track audio_game_integration_20261014 still hold no earshot entry. Closeout should record both notes as debt, or state that none is needed.

F6 [Nit] phase-acceptance (unchanged): measure/gates.json holds only GENERATED_CHECK_COMMAND. The orchestrator supplied the PROJECT_* values, RED_TEST_COMMAND, and GREEN_TEST_COMMAND for each run, with track-scoped values. The repo gate file holds no value for tsc. This is framework state and does not block this phase.

F9 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md has two stale sentences after T8. The Status line at plan.md:3 lists T1 through T4, T6, and T7 as [x] and omits T8. The T8 Red result at plan.md:245-248 says generate.mjs --check exits 1 and the stale fact stays open for closeout, but commit 55ef0204 regenerated the facts and the check exits 0 at HEAD. Update both sentences, or add a dated note. Rationale: the text records a past state, and no behavior differs.
